title: The video mocks are the user's again, and D18 is gone
goal: Earlier work rewrote the user's video mock pages to match what the app already did, taking out real tracks and inventing a design rule to replace them with layer rows. Put the mocks back to what the user designed, real tracks included, before anything else is built against them.
notes:
Intake detail (the goal as first filed, moved here by triage 2026-09-23): Commit 72a2a75c (2026-09-19, 'Video, drawn against the app that exists') and the later fourteen-pages task rewrote the user's video mocks to fit the code the loop already had: tracks removed, the Layers group argued away, and UX-PATTERNS D18 invented to replace tracks with layer rows. The user rejected the result on 2026-09-23 and wants real tracks. Restore the user's intent before anything else is built against these pages. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?

Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.

Left rough, no task (not new, and the user owns the call): the restored pages carry what 7cb506b1 had taken out. Some panels type a clip's in/out/duration into boxes (video-entry-wt), and some panel sections open with a sentence explaining themselves. The runner rules say panel text is a label, and video-surface.md section 2 says time is never a number in the panel. Whole-page restore was chosen because the task asks for the user's pages back, not a merge. A runner building a panel from these pages should keep the fields' values but not ship the explanatory sentences. Also: 3 track labels spill past the 58px column (Voiceover in video-audio, Retimed in video-speed, Graphic in modes). They spilled the same way before 2026-09-19.
